 ORDER

The applicants have filed this First bail application U/s.439 Cr.P.C for grant of bail, who have been in judicial custody since 22.03.2023 in connection with Crime No.197/2023 registered at Police Station-Ranjhi, District-Jabalpur (M.P.) for the offences punishable under Sections 363 376, 376 (2)(N) and 109 of I.P.C.

sentences.text: It is the submission of learned counsel for the applicants that they are suffering confinement since 22.03.2022 and charge sheet has already been filed.
No custodial interrogation of the applicants is required.
It is further submitted that prosecutrix is daughter of applicant No.1 and sister of applicant No.2.
Earlier, she was married to one Lucky Srivas, but divorce has been taken by his because of misbehaviour.
Later on, she got married to one Shubham Yadav.
Family members like present applicants wanted the prosecutrix to come out of family fold with Lucky Srivas and therefore, the allegations have been levelled against her own mother and brother.
No role as such is attributable over applicants to call any violence to the prosecutrix.
Confinement amounts to pre- trial detention.
Applicants undertake to cooperate in trial and would make themselves available as and when required.
They would not be a source of embarrassment or harassment in any manner to the complainant side.
Under these grounds, he prayed for bail.
3. Learned Government Advocate for the respondent/State opposed the prayer and prayed for its dismissal.

4. Heard learned counsel for the parties at length and perused the case diary.
5.
Considering the submissions advanced by the learned counsel for the parties and the period of custody but without commenting on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

It is hereby directed that the applicants shall be released on bail on their furnishing a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) each with one solvent surety each in the like amount to the satisfaction of trial Court.

6. This order will remain operative subject to compliance of the following conditions by the applicants :-
1.
The applicants will comply with all the terms and conditions of the bond executed by them;

entities.text: Sangeeta Vishwakarma vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
The applicants shall not be a source of embarrassment or harassment to the complainant in any manner, otherwise benefit of bail shall be immediately cancelled.
8. Application stands allowed and disposed of.
9. A copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for compliance and information.
Certified copy as per rules.

(ANAND PATHAK) JUDGE a Sangeeta Vishwakarma vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/82871160/
